name: exists_small_nonnegative_tests
stmt: {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (φ : AF → ℝ) (f : ι → AF → ℝ) {N : ℕ} {B ε : ℝ} (hs : ∀ t : AF, (N : ℝ) < |(t : ℝ)| → φ t = 0) (hb : ∀ t, ‖φ t‖ ≤ B) (hp : ∀ t, 0 ≤ φ t) (hI : 0 < integralReal φ hs hb) (hε : 0 < ε) (hf : ∀ i t, 0 ≤ f i t ∧ f i t ≤ 1) (hz : ∀ i, integralReal (fun t => φ t * f i t) (fun t ht => by rw [hs t ht, zero_mul]) (weighted_bound φ (f i) hb (hf i)) = 0) : ∃ t : AF, 0 < φ t ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, f i t < ε

stmt: (hu : ∀ s t v, U s (U t v) = U (s+t) v) (φ : AF → ℝ) {N : ℕ} {B C : ℝ} (hφ : ∀ t : AF, (N : ℝ) < |(t : ℝ)| → φ t = 0) (hb : ∀ t, |φ t| ≤ B) (v : H) (s : AF) (hs : |(s : ℝ)| ≤ 1) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hd : ∀ t, |φ (t-s)-φ t| ≤ C) : ‖U s (smoothedVector U φ hφ hb v) - smoothedVector U φ hφ hb v‖ ≤ (Finset.Icc (-((N+1 : ℕ) : ℤ)-2) (((N+1 : ℕ) : ℤ)+2)).card * (C * ‖v‖)

stmt: (b : L) (hb : IsAlgebraic ℚ b) (ℓ : L →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ) (hd : ∀ t : ℚ, 1-b*(algebraMap ℚ L t) ≠ 0) (h : ∀ t : ℚ, ℓ ((1+b*(algebraMap ℚ L t))/(1-b*(algebraMap ℚ L t))) = 0) : ℓ 1 = 0 ∧ ℓ b = 0 ∧ ℓ (b^2) = 0

name: average_cover_forces_collision
stmt: (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (s : Ω → Finset ι) (f : Ω → ι → κ) (v : Ω → ι → V) (w : Ω → κ → V) (r : ℝ) (hcov : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ i ∈ s x, dist (v x i) (w x (f x i)) ≤ r) (hm : ∀ i j, Measurable (fun x => dist (v x i) (v x j))) (hq : Measurable (fun x => ((s x).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card ι)) (hlarge : 10 * Fintype.card κ < Fintype.card ι) (havg : (19/20 : ℝ) < ∫ x, ((s x).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card ι ∂μ) : ∃ i j : ι, i ≠ j ∧ 1 / (4 * (Fintype.card κ : ℝ)) ≤ μ.real {x | dist (v x i) (v x j) ≤ 2*r}

name: collision_from_close_encodings
stmt: (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (zp zm : Ω → ι → Fin m → Circle) (ap am : ι → Ω → Circle) (j₀ : ι) (hap : ∀ j, Measurable (ap j)) (ham : ∀ j, Measurable (am j)) (hDp : ∀ j, Measurable (fun x => dist (encoding (zp x j)) (encoding (zp x j₀)))) (hDm : ∀ j, Measurable (fun x => dist (encoding (zm x j)) (encoding (zm x j₀)))) (hmem : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ j, (∃ r, ap j x = zp x j r) ∧ (∃ r, am j x = zm x j r)) (hi : ∀ j, Integrable (fun x => dist (encoding (zp x j)) (encoding (zp x j₀))^2 + dist (encoding (zm x j)) (encoding (zm x j₀))^2) μ) (he : ∀ j, (∫ x, dist (encoding (zp x j)) (encoding (zp x j₀))^2 + dist (encoding (zm x j)) (encoding (zm x j₀))^2 ∂μ) < (ρ^m / m)^2 / 20) (hlarge : 10 * m^2 < Fintype.card ι) : ∃ i j : ι, i ≠ j ∧ 1/(4*(m : ℝ)^2) ≤ μ.real {x | dist ((ap i x : ℂ)*(am i x : ℂ)) ((ap j x : ℂ)*(am j x : ℂ)) ≤ 4*ρ}

name: collision_from_measurable_encodings
stmt: (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (zp zm : Ω → ι → Fin m → Circle) (ap am : ι → Ω → Circle) (j₀ : ι) (Hp Hm : ι → Ω → Fin m → ℂ) (henc : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ j, encoding (zp x j) = Hp j x ∧ encoding (zm x j) = Hm j x) (hap : ∀ j, Measurable (ap j)) (ham : ∀ j, Measurable (am j)) (hDp : ∀ j, Measurable (fun x => dist (Hp j x) (Hp j₀ x))) (hDm : ∀ j, Measurable (fun x => dist (Hm j x) (Hm j₀ x))) (hmem : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ j, (∃ r, ap j x = zp x j r) ∧ (∃ r, am j x = zm x j r)) (hi : ∀ j, Integrable (fun x => dist (Hp j x) (Hp j₀ x)^2 + dist (Hm j x) (Hm j₀ x)^2) μ) (he : ∀ j, (∫ x, dist (Hp j x) (Hp j₀ x)^2 + dist (Hm j x) (Hm j₀ x)^2 ∂μ) < (ρ^m / m)^2 / 20) (hlarge : 10 * m^2 < Fintype.card ι) : ∃ i j : ι, i ≠ j ∧ 1/(4*(m : ℝ)^2) ≤ μ.real {x | dist ((ap i x : ℂ)*(am i x : ℂ)) ((ap j x : ℂ)*(am j x : ℂ)) ≤ 4*ρ}

name: applyKernel_covariance
stmt: (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (κ : Kernel Y X) [IsMarkovKernel κ] (q : X → Y) (hq : Measurable q) (L : X × X → ℂ) (hL : Measurable L) (hqcov : ∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, q (k • x) = k • q x) (hκcov : ∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ y ∂μ.map q, κ (k • y) = (κ y).map (fun x => k • x)) (hLcov : ∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ z ∂μ ⊗ₘ κ.comap q hq, L (k • z.1, k • z.2) = L z) (f : X → ℂ) (hfm : Measurable f) (k : K) : (fun x => applyKernel κ q L f (k • x)) =ᵐ[μ] applyKernel κ q L (fun x => f (k • x))

name: norm_sq_le_sub
stmt: (z w : ℂ) : ‖z‖^2 ≤ ‖z-w‖^2 + 2*(z*star w).re

name: exists_nonzero_image
stmt: (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (κ : Kernel Y X) [IsMarkovKernel κ] (q : X → Y) (hq : Measurable q) (L : X × X → ℂ) (hL : Measurable L) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hLC : ∀ z, ‖L z‖ ≤ C) (hne : ¬ L =ᵐ[μ ⊗ₘ κ.comap q hq] 0) : ∃ f : X → ℂ, Measurable f ∧ (∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ 1) ∧ ¬ applyKernel κ q L f =ᵐ[μ] 0

name: measurable_applyKernel
stmt: (κ : Kernel Y X) [IsMarkovKernel κ] (q : X → Y) (hq : Measurable q) (L : X × X → ℂ) (hL : Measurable L) (f : X → ℂ) (hf : Measurable f) : Measurable (applyKernel κ q L f)

name: applyKernel_bound
stmt: (κ : Kernel Y X) [IsMarkovKernel κ] (q : X → Y) (L : X × X → ℂ) (C : ℝ) (hLC : ∀ z, ‖L z‖ ≤ C) (f : X → ℂ) (hfB : ∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ 1) (x : X) : ‖applyKernel κ q L f x‖ ≤ C

name: exists_invariant_set
stmt: (ν : Measure (X × X)) [SMulInvariantMeasure K (X × X) ν] (hn : ¬ ErgodicSMul K (X × X) ν) : ∃ s : Set (X × X), MeasurableSet s ∧ (∀ k : K, (fun z : X × X => k • z) ⁻¹' s =ᵐ[ν] s) ∧ ¬ EventuallyConst s (ae ν)

name: indicator_not_constant
stmt: (ν : Measure (X × X)) (s : Set (X × X)) (hn : ¬ EventuallyConst s (ae ν)) (c : ℂ) : ¬ s.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℂ)) =ᵐ[ν] (fun _ => c)

name: row_constant
stmt: (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [ErgodicSMul K X μ] (κ : Kernel Y X) [IsMarkovKernel κ] (q : X → Y) (hq : Measurable q) (L : X × X → ℂ) (hL : Measurable L) (C : ℝ) (hLC : ∀ z, ‖L z‖ ≤ C) (hqcov : ∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, q (k • x) = k • q x) (hκcov : ∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ y ∂μ.map q, κ (k • y) = (κ y).map (fun x => k • x)) (hLcov : ∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ z ∂μ ⊗ₘ κ.comap q hq, L (k • z.1, k • z.2) = L z) : (fun x => ∫ x', L (x,x') ∂κ (q x)) =ᵐ[μ] (fun _ => ∫ z, L z ∂μ ⊗ₘ κ.comap q hq)

name: centered_kernel
stmt: (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [ErgodicSMul K X μ] (κ : Kernel Y X) [IsMarkovKernel κ] (q : X → Y) (hq : Measurable q) (hswap : (μ ⊗ₘ κ.comap q hq).map Prod.swap = μ ⊗ₘ κ.comap q hq) (hqcov : ∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, q (k • x) = k • q x) (hκcov : ∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ y ∂μ.map q, κ (k • y) = (κ y).map (fun x => k • x)) [SMulInvariantMeasure K (X × X) (μ ⊗ₘ κ.comap q hq)] (hn : ¬ ErgodicSMul K (X × X) (μ ⊗ₘ κ.comap q hq)) : ∃ L : X × X → ℂ, Measurable L ∧ (∀ z, ‖L z‖ ≤ 2) ∧ (∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ z ∂μ ⊗ₘ κ.comap q hq, L (k • z.1, k • z.2) = L z) ∧ ¬ L =ᵐ[μ ⊗ₘ κ.comap q hq] 0 ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, (∫ x', L (x,x') ∂κ (q x)) = 0) ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, (∫ x', L (x',x) ∂κ (q x)) = 0)

name: law_eq_mixture
stmt: (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (q : X → Y) (hq : Measurable q) : law μ q hq = ((condDistrib id q μ).prod (condDistrib id q μ)) ∘ₘ μ.map q

name: law_swap
stmt: (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (q : X → Y) (hq : Measurable q) : (law μ q hq).map Prod.swap = law μ q hq

name: conditional_covariance
stmt: (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (q : X → Y) (hq : Measurable q) (hpres : ∀ k : K, MeasurePreserving (fun x : X => k • x) μ μ) (hqcov : ∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, q (k • x) = k • q x) (k : K) : ∀ᵐ y ∂μ.map q, condDistrib id q μ (k • y) = (condDistrib id q μ y).map (fun x => k • x)

name: law_preserving
stmt: (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (q : X → Y) (hq : Measurable q) (hpres : ∀ k : K, MeasurePreserving (fun x : X => k • x) μ μ) (hqcov : ∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, q (k • x) = k • q x) (k : K) : MeasurePreserving (fun z : X × X => (k • z.1,k • z.2)) (law μ q hq) (law μ q hq)

name: law_invariant
stmt: (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (q : X → Y) (hq : Measurable q) (hpres : ∀ k : K, MeasurePreserving (fun x : X => k • x) μ μ) (hqcov : ∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, q (k • x) = k • q x) : SMulInvariantMeasure K (X × X) (law μ q hq)

name: image_conditional_mean_zero
stmt: (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (q : X → Y) (hq : Measurable q) (L : X × X → ℂ) (hL : Measurable L) (C : ℝ) (hLC : ∀ z, ‖L z‖ ≤ C) (f : X → ℂ) (hfm : Measurable f) (hfB : ∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ 1) (hcol : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, (∫ x', L (x',x) ∂condDistrib id q μ (q x)) = 0) : ∀ᵐ y ∂μ.map q, (∫ x, applyKernel (condDistrib id q μ) q L f x ∂condDistrib id q μ y) = 0

name: nonzero_not_factorizable
stmt: (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (q : X → Y) (hq : Measurable q) (H : X → ℂ) (hn : ¬ H =ᵐ[μ] 0) (hc : ∀ᵐ y ∂μ.map q, (∫ x, H x ∂condDistrib id q μ y) = 0) : ¬ ∃ b : Y → ℂ, Measurable b ∧ H =ᵐ[μ] b ∘ q

name: finite_uniform_fibers
stmt: (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (q : X → Q) (hm : ∀ y : Q, MeasurableSet (q ⁻¹' {y})) {a : ℝ≥0∞} (ha : 0 < a) (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, μ (q ⁻¹' {q x}) = a) : ∃ S : Finset Q, S.Nonempty ∧ (∀ y ∈ S, μ (q ⁻¹' {y}) = a) ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, q x ∈ S) ∧ (S.card : ℝ≥0∞) * a = 1

name: finite_uniform_centers
stmt: (μ : ProbabilityMeasure G) {a : ℝ≥0∞} (ha : 0 < a) (hs : ∀ᵐ z ∂(μ : Measure G), (μ : Measure G) (e.coset z) = a) : ∃ S : Finset G, S.Nonempty ∧ (∀ b ∈ S, (μ : Measure G) ((e.center μ) ⁻¹' {b}) = a) ∧ (∀ᵐ z ∂(μ : Measure G), e.center μ z ∈ S) ∧ (S.card : ℝ≥0∞) * a = 1

name: center_law_ordinary
stmt: (μ : ProbabilityMeasure G) : (μ.map (e.center μ) : Measure G) e.ordinary = (μ : Measure G) e.ordinary

name: ae_eq_const_of_invariant
stmt: {f : X → V} (hf : Measurable f) (hi : ∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, f (k • x) = f x) : ∃ v : V, f =ᵐ[μ] (fun _ => v)

name: compProd_map_base
stmt: (ν : Measure Y) [SFinite ν] (κ : Kernel Y Z) [IsSFiniteKernel κ] (R : Y ≃ᵐ Y) : (ν.map R) ⊗ₘ (κ.comap R.symm R.symm.measurable) = (ν ⊗ₘ κ).map (Prod.map R id)

name: condDistrib_comp_equiv
stmt: [StandardBorelSpace Z] [Nonempty Z] (μ : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (f : X → Z) (p : X → Y) (hf : Measurable f) (hp : Measurable p) (R : Y ≃ᵐ Y) : condDistrib f (R ∘ p) μ =ᵐ[μ.map (R ∘ p)] (condDistrib f p μ).comap R.symm R.symm.measurable

name: condDistrib_equivariant
stmt: [StandardBorelSpace Z] [Nonempty Z] (μ : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (f : X → Z) (p : X → Y) (hf : Measurable f) (hp : Measurable p) (S : X ≃ᵐ X) (R : Y ≃ᵐ Y) (T : Z → Z) (hT : Measurable T) (hS : MeasurePreserving S μ μ) (hRp : p ∘ S =ᵐ[μ] R ∘ p) (hTf : f ∘ S =ᵐ[μ] T ∘ f) : ∀ᵐ y ∂μ.map p, condDistrib f p μ (R y) = (condDistrib f p μ y).map T

name: measurable_probabilityKernel
stmt: (κ : Kernel Y G) [IsMarkovKernel κ] : Measurable (probabilityKernel κ)

name: measurable_cosetMass
stmt: (κ : Kernel Y G) [IsMarkovKernel κ] : Measurable (cosetMass e κ)

name: differenceLaw_ordinary
stmt: (ν : Measure Y) [SFinite ν] (κ : Kernel Y G) [IsMarkovKernel κ] : differenceLaw ν κ e.ordinary = ∫⁻ p : Y × G, cosetMass e κ p ∂ν ⊗ₘ κ

name: sampledMass_integral
stmt: [StandardBorelSpace G] (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (d : X → G) (p : X → Y) (hd : Measurable d) (hp : Measurable p) : differenceLaw (μ.map p) (condDistrib d p μ) e.ordinary = ∫⁻ x, cosetMass e (condDistrib d p μ) (p x, d x) ∂μ

name: positive_mass_finite_centers
stmt: [StandardBorelSpace G] [MeasurableSingletonClass G] {K : Type*} [SMul K X] (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [ErgodicSMul K X μ] (d : X → G) (p : X → Y) (hd : Measurable d) (hp : Measurable p) (hi : ∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, cosetMass e (condDistrib d p μ) (p (k • x), d (k • x)) = cosetMass e (condDistrib d p μ) (p x, d x)) (hpos : 0 < differenceLaw (μ.map p) (condDistrib d p μ) e.ordinary) : ∃ a : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < a ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, cosetMass e (condDistrib d p μ) (p x, d x) = a) ∧ ∀ᵐ y ∂μ.map p, ∃ S : Finset G, S.Nonempty ∧ (∀ b ∈ S, condDistrib d p μ y ((e.center (probabilityKernel (condDistrib d p μ) y)) ⁻¹' {b}) = a) ∧ (∀ᵐ z ∂condDistrib d p μ y, e.center (probabilityKernel (condDistrib d p μ) y) z ∈ S) ∧ (S.card : ℝ≥0∞) * a = 1

name: sampledMass_invariant
stmt: (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [SMulInvariantMeasure K X μ] (d : X → G) (p : X → Y) (hd : Measurable d) (hp : Measurable p) (hde : ∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, d (k • x) = k • d x) (hpe : ∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, p (k • x) = k • p x) (hC : ∀ (k : K) (z : G), k • z ∈ e.ordinary ↔ z ∈ e.ordinary) (k : K) : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, cosetMass e (condDistrib d p μ) (p (k • x), d (k • x)) = cosetMass e (condDistrib d p μ) (p x, d x)

name: measurable_centerMap
stmt: [StandardBorelSpace G] (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (d : X → G) (p : X → Y) (hd : Measurable d) (hp : Measurable p) : Measurable (centerMap e μ d p)

name: centerMap_mem_ordinary_iff
stmt: [StandardBorelSpace G] (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (d : X → G) (p : X → Y) (x : X) : centerMap e μ d p x ∈ e.ordinary ↔ d x ∈ e.ordinary

name: centerMap_law_ordinary
stmt: [StandardBorelSpace G] (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (d : X → G) (p : X → Y) (hd : Measurable d) (hp : Measurable p) : (μ.map (centerMap e μ d p)) e.ordinary = (μ.map d) e.ordinary

name: centerMap_equivariant
stmt: (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [SMulInvariantMeasure K X μ] (d : X → G) (p : X → Y) (hd : Measurable d) (hp : Measurable p) (hde : ∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, d (k • x) = k • d x) (hpe : ∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, p (k • x) = k • p x) (O : K → ℂ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] ℂ) (he : ∀ (k : K) (t : ℂ), k • e.j t = e.j (O k t)) (ha : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, cosetMass e (condDistrib d p μ) (p x, d x) ≠ 0) (k : K) : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, centerMap e μ d p (k • x) = k • centerMap e μ d p x

name: dependentMapKernel_apply
stmt: (κ : Kernel Y G) [IsMarkovKernel κ] (f : Y × G → H) (hf : Measurable f) (y : Y) : ((Kernel.id ×ₖ κ).map f) y = (κ y).map (fun z => f (y, z))

name: compProd_dependentMap
stmt: (ν : Measure Y) [SFinite ν] (κ : Kernel Y G) [IsMarkovKernel κ] (f : Y × G → H) (hf : Measurable f) : ν ⊗ₘ ((Kernel.id ×ₖ κ).map f) = (ν ⊗ₘ κ).map (fun q : Y × G => (q.1, f q))

name: measurable_fiberCenter
stmt: (κ : Kernel Y G) [IsMarkovKernel κ] : Measurable (fun q : Y × G => e.center (probabilityKernel κ q.1) q.2)

name: centerKernel_apply
stmt: (κ : Kernel Y G) [IsMarkovKernel κ] (y : Y) : centerKernel e κ y = (κ y).map (e.center (probabilityKernel κ y))

name: condDistrib_centerMap
stmt: [StandardBorelSpace G] (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (d : X → G) (p : X → Y) (hd : Measurable d) (hp : Measurable p) : condDistrib (centerMap e μ d p) p μ =ᵐ[μ.map p] centerKernel e (condDistrib d p μ)

name: centerKernel_comp_map
stmt: [StandardBorelSpace G] (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (d : X → G) (p : X → Y) (hd : Measurable d) (hp : Measurable p) : centerKernel e (condDistrib d p μ) ∘ₘ (μ.map p) = μ.map (centerMap e μ d p)

name: finite_center_reduction
stmt: (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [ErgodicSMul K X μ] (d : X → G) (p : X → Y) (hd : Measurable d) (hp : Measurable p) (hde : ∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, d (k • x) = k • d x) (hpe : ∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, p (k • x) = k • p x) (O : K → ℂ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] ℂ) (he : ∀ (k : K) (t : ℂ), k • e.j t = e.j (O k t)) (hwild : (μ.map d) e.ordinary = 0) (hpos : 0 < differenceLaw (μ.map p) (condDistrib d p μ) e.ordinary) : Measurable (centerMap e μ d p) ∧ (∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, centerMap e μ d p (k • x) = k • centerMap e μ d p x) ∧ (μ.map (centerMap e μ d p)) e.ordinary = 0 ∧ ∃ a : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < a ∧ ∀ᵐ y ∂μ.map p, ∃ S : Finset G, S.Nonempty ∧ (∀ b ∈ S, condDistrib (centerMap e μ d p) p μ y {b} = a) ∧ (∀ᵐ b ∂condDistrib (centerMap e μ d p) p μ y, b ∈ S) ∧ (S.card : ℝ≥0∞) * a = 1 ∧ (∀ b ∈ S, b ∉ e.ordinary)

name: ordinaryEmbedding_j
stmt: (t : ℂ) : ordinaryEmbedding.j t = j t

name: ordinaryEmbedding_ordinary
stmt: : ordinaryEmbedding.ordinary = C

name: frequencyRotation_apply
stmt: (u : K) (z : ℂ) : frequencyRotation u z = conj (u.val : ℂ) * z

name: action_ordinaryEmbedding
stmt: (u : K) (t : ℂ) : u • ordinaryEmbedding.j t = ordinaryEmbedding.j (frequencyRotation u t)

name: wild_map_of_equivariant
stmt: (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [SMulInvariantMeasure K X μ] (b : X → D) (hb : Measurable b) (hbe : ∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, b (k • x) = k • b x) (hC : (μ.map b) C = 0) : IsWild (μ.map b)

name: exact_finite_center_reduction
stmt: (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [ErgodicSMul K X μ] (d : X → D) (p : X → Y) (hd : Measurable d) (hp : Measurable p) (hde : ∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, d (k • x) = k • d x) (hpe : ∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, p (k • x) = k • p x) (hwild : IsWild (μ.map d)) (hpos : 0 < differenceLaw (μ.map p) (condDistrib d p μ) C) : ∃ b : X → D, Measurable b ∧ (∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, b (k • x) = k • b x) ∧ IsWild (μ.map b) ∧ ∃ a : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < a ∧ ∀ᵐ y ∂μ.map p, ∃ S : Finset D, S.Nonempty ∧ (∀ c ∈ S, condDistrib b p μ y {c} = a) ∧ (∀ᵐ c ∂condDistrib b p μ y, c ∈ S) ∧ (S.card : ℝ≥0∞) * a = 1 ∧ (∀ c ∈ S, c ∉ C)

name: conditional_covariance_add
stmt: (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (q : X → Y) (hq : Measurable q) (hpres : ∀ k : K, MeasurePreserving (fun x : X => k +ᵥ x) μ μ) (hqcov : ∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, q (k +ᵥ x) = k +ᵥ q x) (k : K) : ∀ᵐ y ∂μ.map q, condDistrib id q μ (k +ᵥ y) = (condDistrib id q μ y).map (fun x => k +ᵥ x)

name: law_preserving_add
stmt: (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (q : X → Y) (hq : Measurable q) (hpres : ∀ k : K, MeasurePreserving (fun x : X => k +ᵥ x) μ μ) (hqcov : ∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, q (k +ᵥ x) = k +ᵥ q x) (k : K) : MeasurePreserving (fun z : X × X => (k +ᵥ z.1,k +ᵥ z.2)) (law μ q hq) (law μ q hq)

name: law_invariant_add
stmt: (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (q : X → Y) (hq : Measurable q) (hpres : ∀ k : K, MeasurePreserving (fun x : X => k +ᵥ x) μ μ) (hqcov : ∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, q (k +ᵥ x) = k +ᵥ q x) : VAddInvariantMeasure K (X × X) (law μ q hq)

name: projectCLM_l2
stmt: (f : Func X) : projectCLM μ q hq (l2 μ f) = l2 μ (project μ q hq f)

name: norm_project_l2

name: act_apply
stmt: (g : G) (f : Func X) (x : X) : act g f x = f (g +ᵥ x)

name: act_add
stmt: (g h : G) (f : Func X) : act (g+h) f = act g (act h f)

name: act_mul
stmt: (g : G) (f h : Func X) : act g (f*h) = act g f * act g h

stmt: (g : G) (f : Func X) : act g (bmConj f) = bmConj (act g f)

name: act_sub
stmt: (g : G) (f h : Func X) : act g (f-h) = act g f - act g h

stmt: (g : G) (f : Func X) : l2 μ (act g f) = Amenable.Koopman.action μ g (l2 μ f)

name: project_sub
stmt: (f g : Func X) : project μ q hq (f-g) = project μ q hq f - project μ q hq g

name: project_bound
stmt: (f : Func X) {C : ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ C) (x : X) : ‖project μ q hq f x‖ ≤ C

name: project_comp
stmt: (b : Func Y) : project μ q hq (comp b q hq) =ᵐ[μ] comp b q hq

name: project_project
stmt: (f : Func X) : project μ q hq (project μ q hq f) =ᵐ[μ] project μ q hq f

name: center_project_l2
stmt: (f : Func X) : l2 μ (project μ q hq (f-project μ q hq f)) = 0

name: project_pullout
stmt: (f : Func X) (b : Func Y) : project μ q hq (f * comp b q hq) =ᵐ[μ] project μ q hq f * comp b q hq

name: integral_mul_lift
stmt: (f : Func X) (b : Func Y) : ∫ x, (f * comp b q hq) x ∂μ = ∫ x, (project μ q hq f * comp b q hq) x ∂μ

name: conditional_act
stmt: (g : G) (f : Func X) : conditional μ q (act g f) =ᵐ[μ.map q] act g (conditional μ q f)

name: act_lift
stmt: (g : G) (b : Func Y) : act g (comp b q hq) =ᵐ[μ] comp (act g b) q hq

name: project_act
stmt: (g : G) (f : Func X) : project μ q hq (act g f) =ᵐ[μ] act g (project μ q hq f)

name: norm_le_bound
stmt: (F : Family G X) (g : G) (x : X) : ‖F g x‖ ≤ F.bound

name: ext

name: add_apply
stmt: (F H : Family G X) (g : G) : (F+H) g = F g + H g

name: mul_apply
stmt: (F H : Family G X) (g : G) : (F*H) g = F g * H g

name: sub_apply
stmt: (F H : Family G X) (g : G) : (F-H) g = F g - H g

name: zero_apply
stmt: (g : G) : (0 : Family G X) g = 0

name: one_apply
stmt: (g : G) : (1 : Family G X) g = 1

name: real_smul_apply
stmt: (c : ℝ) (F : Family G X) (g : G) : (c • F) g = c • F g

name: complex_smul_apply
stmt: (c : ℂ) (F : Family G X) (g : G) : (c • F) g = c • F g

name: prod_apply
stmt: {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (F : ι → Family G X) (g : G) : (∏ i ∈ s, F i) g = ∏ i ∈ s, F i g

name: const_apply
stmt: (f : Func X) (g : G) : const f g = f

name: conj_apply
stmt: (F : Family G X) (g : G) : bmConj F g = BoundedMeasurable.bmConj (F g)

name: toL2_apply
stmt: (F : Family G X) (g : G) : toL2 μ F g = l2 μ (F g)

name: avg_pair
stmt: (F : Family G X) (h : Lp ℂ 2 μ) : inner ℝ (avg μ M F) h = M.map (Amenable.Mean.pairing (toL2 μ F) h)

name: avg_congr_ae
stmt: {F H : Family G X} (he : ∀ g, F g =ᵐ[μ] H g) : avg μ M F = avg μ M H

name: orbit_apply
stmt: (φ : G →+ G) (f : Func X) (g : G) : orbit φ f g = act (φ g) f

name: orbit_add
stmt: (φ : G →+ G) (f h : Func X) : orbit φ (f+h) = orbit φ f + orbit φ h

name: orbit_sub
stmt: (φ : G →+ G) (f h : Func X) : orbit φ (f-h) = orbit φ f - orbit φ h

name: tensor_apply
stmt: (f : Func X) (g : Func Y) (z : X×Y) : tensor f g z = f z.1 * g z.2

name: tensor_mul
stmt: (f h : Func X) (g k : Func Y) : tensor (f*h) (g*k) = tensor f g * tensor h k

name: tensor_conj
stmt: (f : Func X) (g : Func Y) : tensor (bmConj f) (bmConj g) = bmConj (tensor f g)

name: integral_law
stmt: (f : Func (X×X)) : ∫ z, f z ∂(RelativeProduct.law μ q hq) = ∫ y, (∫ z, f z ∂(condDistrib id q μ y).prod (condDistrib id q μ y)) ∂μ.map q

name: integral_tensor
stmt: (f g : Func X) : ∫ z, tensor f g z ∂(RelativeProduct.law μ q hq) = ∫ y, conditional μ q f y * conditional μ q g y ∂μ.map q

name: integral_tensor_self
stmt: (f : Func X) : ∫ z, tensor f (bmConj f) z ∂(RelativeProduct.law μ q hq) = (‖l2 (μ.map q) (conditional μ q f)‖^2 : ℝ)

name: inner_tensor
stmt: (v w : Func X) : inner ℝ (l2 (RelativeProduct.law μ q hq) (tensor w (bmConj w))) (l2 (RelativeProduct.law μ q hq) (tensor (bmConj v) v)) = ‖l2 (μ.map q) (conditional μ q (v*w))‖^2

name: vector_orbit_hom_zero
stmt: (M : Mean G) (φ : G →+ G) (hs : Function.Surjective φ) (v : Lp E 2 μ) (hv : ∫ x, v x ∂μ = 0) : M.vector (Mean.orbit (fun g => action (E := E) μ (φ g)) v) = 0

name: pairSequence_apply
stmt: (φ : G →+ G) (v w : Func X) (g : G) : pairSequence μ q hq φ v w g = l2 (μ.map q) (conditional μ q (v*act (φ g) w))

name: tensor_act
stmt: (g : G) (v w : Func X) : tensor (act g v) (act g w) = act g (tensor v w)

name: pair_mean_sq_zero
stmt: (M : Amenable.Mean G) (φ : G →+ G) (hs : Function.Surjective φ) (v w : Func X) (hw : l2 (μ.map q) (conditional μ q w) = 0) : M.map (Amenable.Mean.squareNorm (pairSequence μ q hq φ v w)) = 0

name: mixed_prod
stmt: (s t : Finset ι) (ht : t ⊆ s) (f g : ι → A) : (∏ i ∈ t, f i) * (∏ i ∈ s\t, g i) = ∏ i ∈ s, if i∈t then f i else g i

name: linear_prod_replace
stmt: (L : A →ₗ[R] H) (s : Finset ι) (f g : ι → A) (h : ∀ t ∈ s.powerset, t ≠ ∅ → L ((∏ i ∈ t, (f i - g i)) * ∏ i ∈ s\t, g i) = 0) : L (∏ i ∈ s, f i) = L (∏ i ∈ s, g i)

name: add_prod_replace
stmt: (L : A →+ H) (s : Finset ι) (f g : ι → A) (h : ∀ t ∈ s.powerset, t ≠ ∅ → L ((∏ i ∈ t, (f i - g i)) * ∏ i ∈ s\t, g i) = 0) : L (∏ i ∈ s, f i) = L (∏ i ∈ s, g i)

name: vector_real
stmt: (f : G →ᵇ ℝ) : M.vector f = M.map f

name: norm_mean_zero_of_square
stmt: {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] (V : G →ᵇ H) (h : M.map (squareNorm V) = 0) : M.map (normFn V) = 0

name: l2_inner
stmt: (f h : Func X) : inner ℝ (l2 μ f) (l2 μ h) = (∫ x, (bmConj f * h) x ∂μ).re

name: inner_act
stmt: (g : G) (f h : Func X) : inner ℝ (l2 μ (act g f)) (l2 μ (act g h)) = inner ℝ (l2 μ f) (l2 μ h)

name: integral_act
stmt: (g : G) (f : Func X) : ∫ x, act g f x ∂μ = ∫ x, f x ∂μ

name: l2_mul_norm_le
stmt: (f h : Func X) {C : ℝ} (hC : ∀ x, ‖h x‖ ≤ C) : ‖l2 μ (f*h)‖ ≤ C * ‖l2 μ f‖

name: func_prod_apply
stmt: (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Func X) (x : X) : (∏ i ∈ s, f i) x = ∏ i ∈ s, f i x

name: conj_conj
stmt: (f : Func X) : bmConj (bmConj f) = f

name: conj_mul
stmt: (f h : Func X) : bmConj (f*h) = bmConj f * bmConj h

name: conj_prod
stmt: (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Func X) : bmConj (∏ i ∈ s, f i) = ∏ i ∈ s, bmConj (f i)

name: comp_prod
stmt: {Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Y] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Func Y) (q : X → Y) (hq : Measurable q) : comp (∏ i ∈ s, f i) q hq = ∏ i ∈ s, comp (f i) q hq

name: act_prod
stmt: (g : G) (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Func X) : act g (∏ i ∈ s, f i) = ∏ i ∈ s, act g (f i)

name: act_zero
stmt: (f : Func X) : act (0 : G) f = f

name: prod_orbit_correlation
stmt: (s : Finset ι) (φ : ι → G →+ G) (f : ι → Func X) (u h : G) : (∏ i ∈ s, act (φ i (u+h)) (f i)) * bmConj (∏ i ∈ s, act (φ i u) (f i)) = ∏ i ∈ s, act (φ i u) (act (φ i h) (f i) * bmConj (f i))

name: prod_shift_erase
stmt: (s : Finset ι) (j : ι) (hj : j∈s) (φ : ι → G →+ G) (f : ι → Func X) (u : G) : (∏ i ∈ s, act (φ i u) (f i)) = act (φ j u) (f j * ∏ i ∈ s.erase j, act ((φ i - φ j) u) (f i))

name: l2_inner_mul
stmt: (f h : Func X) : inner ℝ (l2 μ f) (l2 μ (bmConj h)) = (∫ x, (f*h) x ∂μ).re

name: correlation_product
stmt: (M : Amenable.Mean G) (s : Finset ι) (j : ι) (hj : j∈s) (φ : ι → G →+ G) (f : ι → Func X) (h : G) : M.correlation (Family.toL2 μ (∏ i ∈ s, Family.orbit (φ i) (f i))) (Family.toL2 μ (∏ i ∈ s, Family.orbit (φ i) (f i))) h = inner ℝ (Family.avg μ M (∏ i ∈ s.erase j, Family.orbit (φ i - φ j) (act (φ i h) (f i) * bmConj (f i)))) (l2 μ (bmConj (act (φ j h) (f j) * bmConj (f j))))

name: norm_l2_conj
stmt: (f : Func X) : ‖l2 μ (bmConj f)‖ = ‖l2 μ f‖

name: inner_replace_project
stmt: (w h : Func X) (b : Func Y) (hw : w =ᵐ[μ] comp b q hq) : inner ℝ (l2 μ w) (l2 μ (bmConj h)) = inner ℝ (l2 μ w) (l2 μ (bmConj (project μ q hq h)))

name: inner_project_bound
stmt: (w h : Func X) (b : Func Y) (hw : w =ᵐ[μ] comp b q hq) {C : ℝ} (hC : ∀ x, ‖w x‖ ≤ C) : |inner ℝ (l2 μ w) (l2 μ (bmConj h))| ≤ C * ‖l2 μ (project μ q hq h)‖

name: avg_project_bound
stmt: (M : Amenable.Mean G) (W : Family G X) (h : Func X) (b : G → Func Y) (hw : ∀ g, W g =ᵐ[μ] comp (b g) q hq) {C : ℝ} (hC : ∀ g x, ‖W g x‖ ≤ C) : |inner ℝ (Family.avg μ M W) (l2 μ (bmConj h))| ≤ C * ‖l2 μ (project μ q hq h)‖

name: prod_act_project_lift
stmt: (s : Finset ι) (ψ : ι → G →+ G) (f : ι → Func X) (u : G) : (∏ i ∈ s, act (ψ i u) (project μ q hq (f i))) =ᵐ[μ] comp (∏ i ∈ s, act (ψ i u) (conditional μ q (f i))) q hq

name: pairVanishing_of_ergodic
stmt: [ErgodicVAdd G (X×X) (RelativeProduct.law μ q hq)] (M : Amenable.Mean G) : PairVanishing μ q hq M

name: Admissible.erase_diff
stmt: {s : Finset ι} {φ : ι → G →+ G} (ha : Admissible s φ) {j : ι} (hj : j∈s) : Admissible (s.erase j) (fun i => φ i - φ j)

name: avg_product_zero_of_pair
stmt: (M : Amenable.Mean G) (hpair : PairVanishing μ q hq M) (s : Finset ι) (φ : ι → G →+ G) (f : ι → Func X) (ha : Admissible s φ) (hc : ∃ j∈s, l2 μ (project μ q hq (f j)) = 0) : Family.avg μ M (∏ i∈s, Family.orbit (φ i) (f i)) = 0

name: meanNorm_nonneg
stmt: (F : Family G X) : 0 ≤ meanNorm μ M F

name: meanNorm_mono
stmt: {F H : Family G X} (h : ∀ g, ‖l2 μ (F g)‖ ≤ ‖l2 μ (H g)‖) : meanNorm μ M F ≤ meanNorm μ M H

name: meanNorm_congr
stmt: {F H : Family G X} (h : ∀ g, F g =ᵐ[μ] H g) : meanNorm μ M F = meanNorm μ M H

name: meanNorm_le
stmt: {F : Family G X} {C : ℝ} (h : ∀ g, ‖l2 μ (F g)‖ ≤ C) : meanNorm μ M F ≤ C

name: meanNorm_zero
stmt: : meanNorm μ M (0 : Family G X) = 0

name: meanNorm_add_le
stmt: (F H : Family G X) : meanNorm μ M (F+H) ≤ meanNorm μ M F + meanNorm μ M H

name: meanNorm_neg
stmt: (F : Family G X) : meanNorm μ M (-F) = meanNorm μ M F

name: meanNorm_sub_le
stmt: (F H : Family G X) : meanNorm μ M (F-H) ≤ meanNorm μ M F + meanNorm μ M H

name: meanNorm_mul_le
stmt: (F H : Family G X) {C : ℝ} (hC : ∀ g x, ‖H g x‖ ≤ C) : meanNorm μ M (F*H) ≤ C * meanNorm μ M F

name: meanNorm_const
stmt: (f : Func X) : meanNorm μ M (const f : Family G X) = ‖l2 μ f‖

name: meanNorm_add_zero
stmt: {F H : Family G X} (hF : meanNorm μ M F = 0) (hH : meanNorm μ M H = 0) : meanNorm μ M (F+H) = 0

name: meanNorm_mul_zero
stmt: {F H : Family G X} (hF : meanNorm μ M F = 0) : meanNorm μ M (F*H) = 0

name: meanNorm_sum_zero
stmt: {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (F : ι → Family G X) (hF : ∀ i∈s, meanNorm μ M (F i) = 0) : meanNorm μ M (∑ i∈s, F i) = 0

name: meanNorm_eq_zero_of_approx
stmt: {F : Family G X} (h : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ H : Family G X, meanNorm μ M H = 0 ∧ ∀ g, ‖l2 μ (F g - H g)‖ ≤ ε) : meanNorm μ M F = 0

name: conditional_apply
stmt: (F : Family G X) (g : G) : conditional μ q F g = BoundedMeasurable.conditional μ q (F g)

name: conditional_add
stmt: (F H : Family G X) : conditional μ q (F+H) = conditional μ q F + conditional μ q H

name: conditional_sub
stmt: (F H : Family G X) : conditional μ q (F-H) = conditional μ q F - conditional μ q H

name: covariance_apply
stmt: (φ : G →+ G) (v w : Func X) (g : G) : covariance μ q φ v w g = conditional μ q (v*act (φ g) w) - conditional μ q v * act (φ g) (conditional μ q w)

name: covariance_add_left
stmt: (φ : G →+ G) (v v' w : Func X) : covariance μ q φ (v+v') w = covariance μ q φ v w + covariance μ q φ v' w

name: covariance_add_right
stmt: (φ : G →+ G) (v w w' : Func X) : covariance μ q φ v (w+w') = covariance μ q φ v w + covariance μ q φ v w'

name: conditional_mul_project_act
stmt: (g : G) (v w : Func X) : conditional μ q (v*act g (project μ q hq w)) =ᵐ[μ.map q] conditional μ q v * act g (conditional μ q w)

name: covariance_center
stmt: (φ : G →+ G) (v w : Func X) (g : G) : covariance μ q φ v w g =ᵐ[μ.map q] conditional μ q (v*act (φ g) (w-project μ q hq w))

name: covariance_mean_zero
stmt: (M : Amenable.Mean G) (hp : PairVanishing μ q hq M) (φ : G →+ G) (hs : Function.Surjective φ) (v w : Func X) : Family.meanNorm (μ.map q) M (covariance μ q φ v w) = 0

name: inner_norm
stmt: (f : C(X,ℝ)) (b : B) : ‖inner t r x₀ f b‖ ≤ ‖f‖

name: inner_add
stmt: (f g : C(X,ℝ)) (b : B) : inner t r x₀ (f+g) b = inner t r x₀ f b + inner t r x₀ g b

name: inner_smul
stmt: (c : ℝ) (f : C(X,ℝ)) (b : B) : inner t r x₀ (c • f) b = c • inner t r x₀ f b

name: outer_add
stmt: (f g : C(X,ℝ)) : outer t r x₀ (f+g) = outer t r x₀ f + outer t r x₀ g

name: outer_smul
stmt: (c : ℝ) (f : C(X,ℝ)) : outer t r x₀ (c • f) = c • outer t r x₀ f

name: average_add
stmt: (f g : C(X,ℝ)) : average t r x₀ (f+g) = average t r x₀ f + average t r x₀ g

name: average_smul
stmt: (c : ℝ) (f : C(X,ℝ)) : average t r x₀ (c • f) = c * average t r x₀ f

name: average_mono
stmt: {f g : C(X,ℝ)} (h : f ≤ g) : average t r x₀ f ≤ average t r x₀ g

name: average_const
stmt: (c : ℝ) : average t r x₀ (ContinuousMap.const X c) = c

name: average_translation
stmt: (ht : ∀ a b x, t a (t b x) = t (a+b) x) (φ : B → A → A) (hc : ∀ a b x, t a (r b x) = r b (t (φ b a) x)) (a : A) (f : C(X,ℝ)) (ha : Continuous (t a)) : average t r x₀ (f.comp ⟨t a,ha⟩) = average t r x₀ f

name: average_rotation
stmt: (hr : ∀ a b x, r a (r b x) = r (a+b) x) (b : B) (f : C(X,ℝ)) (hb : Continuous (r b)) : average t r x₀ (f.comp ⟨r b,hb⟩) = average t r x₀ f

name: integral
stmt: (f : C(X,ℝ)) : ∫ x, f x ∂measure t r x₀ = average t r x₀ f

name: preserving_of_average
stmt: (s : X ≃ₜ X) (hav : ∀ f : C(X,ℝ), average t r x₀ (f.comp ⟨s,s.continuous⟩) = average t r x₀ f) : MeasurePreserving s (measure t r x₀) (measure t r x₀)

name: exists_terminal_factor
stmt: (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [ErgodicSMul K X μ] : ∃ p : X → OrbitSpace K, ∃ hp : Measurable p, (∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, p (k • x) = k • p x) ∧ UniversalGood μ p ∧ ErgodicSMul K (X × X) (RelativeProduct.law μ p hp)
